title: Catalogue skills
description: The catalogue's skills entries (skills spec, "The catalogue"; ADR 0029), in the order the Skills step shows them: repository folders a person may tick to track as skill sources. None is ticked or always-on until a person acts. An entry shows ticked when a source of the environment's (skills.get) has its repository identity (cases/repository-identity.json, with no forge accounts) and its folder, and names that source; unticking removes the source. Each entry's skillCount equals its members, each member named once; each always-on hint is one of its members, named once; ids are unique and no two entries share an identity and folder. A licence's spdx is null exactly when where is none, and it carries a note whenever where is not a file or holder is null.
